title: OpsBridge AI document review evaluation, fixture mode
disclosure: Deterministic demonstration fixture. These are results for a labeled-line extractor whose answers are stored with the seed, run through the app's real validation, policy and decision path. They are not live-model accuracy. No language model was called.
hostileOutputSource: In-process labeled test double on the live path (no provider contacted)
environment: Local: Node 22, in-process Hono app, Docker Postgres 17. Not Cloudflare hardware.
testsRun: 40 fixture documents: attach, review, re-validate stored output, accept and apply through the API, check side effects
12 hostile model outputs through the owner live path against a test double

latencyMs.note: Whole API call, in-process, local Postgres

tokens.note: Fixture mode makes no model call

limitations: Fixture mode: the extractor was written by the same session that wrote the documents, though it never reads the expected answers. Treat accuracy as a regression baseline for the pipeline, not as evidence of model quality.
40 synthetic documents with a narrow, labeled layout. Real documents vary far more.
Image-only scans are excluded from accuracy (PRD 10.4) and scored only for abstention.
The live path has met only a labeled test double. Live-model accuracy, latency and cost are Pending Owner Credentials (DEC-008).
This does not establish comprehensive security or safety (PRD 10.4).
